title: Ask for a small ordered result
summary: A search request can limit its hit count and sort by a field.
introduction: A search request can limit its hit count and sort by a field. Your task: Change the sort to descending pages.
learningObjectives: Change the sort to descending pages.
Explain the example for ask for a small ordered result

blocks.text: A search request can limit its hit count and sort by a field. Source filtering returns only the fields the page needs.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.

blocks.title: Ask for a small ordered result

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `_source` filtering chooses which stored source fields are returned. It does not change the original indexed document.

blocks.text: At most two shortest sample documents are returned with title and pages in their source.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: For deep pagination, learn search_after with a stable sort. Large from offsets are not a free way to scan everything.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the sort to descending pages.
